articles.summary: Investment in SBA loan fund expands access to capital for local businesses and job creation EVERETT, Wash., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Coastal Community Bank (the “Bank”, “Coastal”, “us”, “our”, “we”) announced a $5 million investment in the Solomon Hess SBA Loan Fund, reinforcing the Bank's commitment to supporting small businesses, economic development, and job creation throughout Snohomish and King Counties. The investment advances Coastal's Federal Reserve-approved Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) Strategic Plan and expands access to capital for businesses that may not qualify for traditional financing. The investment supports the SBA 7(a) loan program, which helps small businesses secure financing needed to grow, create jobs, and contribute to local economic development.
